ui.blast.count: Paths: {n}. Contents are not read or shown.
ui.blast.none: None found in the dropped folder
ui.blast.title: Blast radius
ui.cli.body: The browser cannot see processes, network connections, the kernel, eBPF or mounts, so zero findings here does not mean the machine is safe.
ui.cli.title: Host checks need the CLI
ui.cli_note.ai_assistant: Use the CLI to check the installed Cursor and Copilot versions.
ui.cli_note.anti_forensics: The browser cannot see noatime mounts or whether auditd / OpenBSM is running.
ui.cli_note.ebpf: The browser cannot read bpftool, lsmod, /proc or /sys/fs/bpf.
ui.cli_note.persistence: Use the CLI to check crontab, launchctl and systemd on the host.
ui.cli_note.post_shaihulud: Use the CLI to check processes (such as a fake cargo-install) and binaries outside your home directory.
ui.cli_note.sigstore: Use the CLI to check the installed cosign version.
ui.empty.none: No findings from the browser checks. Run the CLI for host checks.
ui.empty.start: Drop a folder or paste some text to start.
ui.error.body: The loaded data may contain a value that cannot be displayed. Clear the results and try again. File contents are never sent anywhere.
ui.error.title: Something went wrong while showing the results
ui.findings.title: Findings
ui.header.csp_note: This page never connects to the network (CSP connect-src 'none', no web fonts or CDN).
ui.intake.sub: File contents are used only for matching. They are never shown, saved or sent.
ui.intake.title: Drop a folder to scan
ui.lang.title: Language
ui.paste.hint: Looks for C2 domains and IPs, base64, exec( and curl
ui.paste.placeholder1: Paste logs, shell history or config snippets.
ui.paste.placeholder2: The text is never shown again.
ui.paste.title: Check pasted text
ui.sp.diff_body: Drop the previous version's contract together with this one to catch permissions widened without a major version bump (SkillPact §17). The browser never contacts a registry.
ui.sp.effects_note: read counts only signs of reading sensitive files (~/.ssh, .env, credentials). write includes lasting writes outside the work area (crontab, .bashrc). Declared means permissions.*.level is not none.
ui.sp.empty: No skills found (SKILL.md or skill.contract.json). Drop a skill folder.
ui.sp.empty_note: Experimental: checks whether the permissions an AI agent skill declares (SkillPact contract skill.contract.json) match what its code actually does (static analysis).
ui.sp.experimental: Experimental. ZES only parses the contract as JSON. It never runs the skill or its L2 tests and never verifies signatures.
ui.sp.filter: Filter by skill name or path
ui.sp.level_note: ZES does not verify signatures or run tests, so it never reports L2 or L3. Even L3 does not mean safe.

ui.sp.no_prev: Cannot compare: the previous contract was not provided
ui.sp.no_safe: No SAFE label here: ZES does not certify skills as safe.
ui.sp.rules_summary: Rules: {n}. Matched: {hit}, no match or not applicable: {clear}, inconclusive: {und}
ui.sp.signed_title: The contract has integrity.signatures. ZES does not verify signatures, and a signature never changes the severity.
ui.sp.signed_warn: ZES warns about added permissions even when the contract is signed
ui.sp.unit: One entry per directory with SKILL.md or a contract file
ui.sp.widened: Permissions widened without a major version bump
ui.sp.widened_body: SkillPact §17: widening permissions should bump the major version so users are asked again. ZES warns even when the contract is signed, because a signature is not a reason to trust it.
ui.spec.exec_tip: ZES never runs or installs your files.
ui.tabsearch.label: Search tabs
ui.tabsearch.note: Tabs are in a fixed order. Numbers are finding counts.
ui.theme.title: Theme
ui.toast.busy_drop: A scan is running. Drop the folder again when it finishes.
ui.toast.clipboard_fail: Clipboard is not available. Copy it from the field below.
ui.toast.drop_unreadable: Could not read the dropped folder. Try "Choose folder…" or the CLI.
ui.toast.imported_dropped: Loaded findings.json from the CLI. Skipped (does not match the schema): {n}
ui.toast.pasted: Checked the pasted text. The text is not kept.
ui.toast.scan_failed: The scan failed. No results are shown.
ui.toast.zero_files: No files were received. Some browsers do not pass folders that contain only hidden files (such as .mcp.json). Use drag and drop or the CLI instead.
ui.und.title: Not scanned (not counted as clean)
ui.viewer.actions_desc: Groups uses: references into pinned to SHA, tag, possibly poisoned and local.
ui.viewer.ext_desc: Shows dangerous permission names and <all_urls>. The update_url value is never shown.
ui.viewer.mcp_desc: Shows only command and args (up to 120 characters). Dangerous commands are marked CRITICAL, ones to review MEDIUM.
